historical_native_task0_control.interpretation: The known native-task control is repeatable in binary success, although rollout length varies. It is not a positive control for the distinct custom LIBERO-36 task-0 BDDL/instruction.

historical_positive_control_repeatabilit.interpretation: Stable binary success under one fixed native LIBERO-Spatial condition; not proof of trajectory determinism or custom LIBERO-36 success.

current_native_single_task_pipeline_cont.scope: native LIBERO Spatial task 0 only; does not establish capability on custom LIBERO-36 task 0

source_data_parity_audit.image_pixel_checks: agentview and wrist images matched exactly at three sampled frames per episode; not an exhaustive all-frame image comparison
source_data_parity_audit.hdf5_task_instruction: pick up the akita black bowl and place it on the plate in the left region
source_data_parity_audit.interpretation: The action and state data conversion is exact for all five episodes. This does not establish that the recovered historical checkpoint was trained from these exact bytes or that every image frame is identical.

source_demo_replay_qc.source: HDF5 data/demo_0..demo_4 attributes read-only on the GPU; each contains 658 frames

strict_evaluation.predeclared_gate: at least 28/50 success with no evaluator or deterministic-algorithm errors

historical_checkpoint_cross_task_probe.interpretation: This is a cross-task diagnostic, not a valid positive control: the checkpoint's confirmed repeatability evidence is on native LIBERO Spatial task 0, whereas these rollouts used the custom LIBERO-36 task, instruction, BDDL, and held-out initial-state manifest. Do not use these 0/50 results to claim evaluator failure or historical checkpoint failure.

pending_diagnostic.scope: diagnostic only; five HDF5 demonstration initial states; no training and no official benchmark change
pending_diagnostic.smoke_result: verified complete: on demo_0 both recovered_historical_v3 and stageE1_custom_task0_10k failed (0/1 each, reward 0); strict inference pipeline and unique output writing completed
pending_diagnostic.full_diagnostic_first_attempt: failed before rollout: ModuleNotFoundError for eval_v3_task0 because the eval scripts directory was not on PYTHONPATH; original log retained and no output directory was created
pending_diagnostic.runtime_fix: set PYTHONPATH=/root/smolvla-eval-prep/scripts; no source, model, data, or inference protocol changes
pending_diagnostic.protocol_caveat: Each HDF5 initial simulator state was restored and then followed by 10 open-gripper wait actions. The collector records the HDF5 state after passive settle, so this is not an exact action-start replay.

zero_wait_paired_diagnostic.interpretation_limit: Historical checkpoint was trained for native LIBERO Spatial task 0, not this custom LIBERO-36 task; only the StageE1 checkpoint is a task-matched model.

teacher_forced_action_fit_audit.sampling: 665 frames sampled every five frames across all five training episodes; policy state reset per recorded observation; first postprocessed action compared with aligned expert action
teacher_forced_action_fit_audit.interpretation: The current checkpoint closely matches one-step expert actions on these sampled in-distribution observations in absolute terms; this does not explain or override 0/50 held-out and 0/5 zero-wait closed-loop results, and does not prove causal sufficiency.

action_chunk_horizon_fit_audit.interpretation: No evidence of error growth across the predicted chunk on these in-sample demonstrations. This does not resolve why strict held-out and zero-wait closed-loop success remain 0; closed-loop state distribution, execution dynamics, and generalization remain untested by this audit.

training_image_parity_audit.episode_mapping: unique full-sequence exact action plus 15-D state matching; no file-order assumption
training_image_parity_audit.interpretation: Source HDF5 and frozen LeRobot image payloads match exactly for every task0 frame in both cameras; action and state also match exactly. This closes the raw-data conversion parity gap but does not verify post-preprocessing model tensors or explain closed-loop failure.

model_input_preprocessing_parity_audit.interpretation: All 25 recorded observations had exact camera pixels and stored 15-D state match between LeRobot loader and evaluator frame construction, and all model-preprocessor outputs matched exactly after canonicalizing the singleton observation-time dimension. The HDF5 has no raw quaternion, so the dynamic simulator quaternion-to-axis-angle path was not bitwise compared. This closes recorded-frame preprocessing parity, not all live-state construction or closed-loop behavior.

live_quaternion_conversion_audit.interpretation: The training collector and strict evaluator produced effectively identical axis-angle values on the exact replayed demonstration quaternions (max difference 1.20e-7). This provides no evidence that this conversion difference explains the custom task0 failure within the demonstrated trajectories; policy-generated states remain outside scope.

checkpoint_learning_curve_audit.interpretation: In-sample action fit improves substantially across saved checkpoints, but this does not establish held-out or closed-loop capability and does not change the StageE1 gate.

pending_diagnostic.next_action: Preserve custom StageE1 0/50. Native task0 single-task separately met its gate (fixed init 5/5, paired 20-init 12/20), and recovered historical init0 repeated 5/5. Before task-count scaling, source and validate matching official native LIBERO-Spatial task0-3 demonstrations; currently available custom LIBERO-36 definitions are not interchangeable. Do not launch mixed-family training.
